data_quality: Partial — mix of sector-level (Australia, 2003) and company-level (Newmont global, 2024)

sources.source_name: Foran et al. 2005 Balancing Act Vol 2
sources.notes: Sector-level TBL benchmarks. Australian gold and lead sector.
Company-level operational metrics. World's largest gold miner. Third-party verified.

ndc_notes.D_institutional_confirmed: LBMA Responsible Gold Guidance compliance verified by customer audits at mine level (Ahafo South, Lihir, Yanacocha). D-institutional burden of LBMA extends upstream to Phase 1, not only to Phase 4 refining.
ndc_notes.C_fragility_flag: 24% of supplier base carries elevated human rights risk (194/812 screened). Structural C-fragility in supplier network.
ndc_notes.D_natural_evidence: Land reclamation (192 ha/2024) confirms irreducible physical closure obligations. Progressive land disturbance is non-negotiable at Phase 1.
ndc_notes.economic_scale: Newmont alone contributed USD 16.0B direct economic value and USD 69M community investment in 2024.
